profile.headline: Frontend Software Engineer | E-commerce & Personalization | JavaScript, A/B Testing, APIs
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Frontend engineer with experience building e-commerce and customer-focused web applications. Background in hospitality and retail, bringing strong user empathy and business understanding into technical solutions. I enjoy solving problems that sit at the intersection of technology and real-world user experience.

Technical Skills
	• Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React
	• Backend / Data: SQL, Firebase
	• Tools: Git, Bitbucket, Jira
	• Concepts: OOP, REST APIs, MVC, responsive design

GitHub: github.com/jrosario

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Implement and optimize personalized user experiences using Adobe Target across high-traffic e-commerce platforms

• Collaborate with UX/UI and marketing teams to design and launch A/B tests and targeted campaigns that improve user engagement and conversion rates

• Develop and deploy dynamic content for landing pages and multichannel campaigns, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and responsive design

• Utilize APIs and tools like Postman to test and validate integrations for personalization features

• Contribute to scalable frontend solutions by applying modern web standards, coding best practices, and performance optimization techniques

Technologies: Adobe Target, HTML5, JavaScript, REST APIs, Postman
positions.insights: Cross-browser Compatibility, Landing Pages and +8 skills

positions.title: Senior Front End Software Developer
positions.locationName: Rochelle Park, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Supported enterprise client in e-commerce environment

• Improved page performance and load time

• Contributed to A/B testing initiatives using Google Optimize

• Worked on high-traffic platforms

• Gathered and translated business requirements into scalable frontend solutions for enterprise web applications

• Developed and enhanced user-facing features using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, ensuring cross-browser 
compatibility and responsive design

• Partnered with stakeholders to identify technical solutions that improved user experience and streamlined business workflows

• Led code reviews and enforced coding standards to maintain high-quality, maintainable codebases

• Coordinated data integration and migration efforts between internal systems and third-party services

• Prepared and deployed production-ready code, ensuring stability and reliability across releases

• Documented system architecture and implementation details to support ongoing development and team collaboration

Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Google Optimize, A/B Testing
positions.insights: Cross-browser Compatibility, Landing Pages and +7 skills

positions.title: Front End Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and tested frontend features for web applications, ensuring responsive design and cross-browser compatibility

• Built proof-of-concept applications to evaluate new technologies and improve product development workflows

• Collaborated directly with clients to gather requirements and deliver customized technical solutions

• Provided production support by troubleshooting issues and maintaining application stability

• Contributed to improving user experience by identifying and implementing modern frontend practices
positions.insights: Cross-browser Compatibility, Landing Pages and +6 skills

positions.title: Senior Developer - Multimedia
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained interactive web and multimedia applications used across major resort properties including Bellagio, MGM Grand, Aria, and Mandalay Bay

• Delivered customer-facing digital experiences for high-traffic environments, ensuring reliability and performance

• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design, build, and deploy new features based on business and operational requirements

• Managed application deployments and supported production systems, troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues

• Maintained data integrity and system performance across enterprise applications through monitoring, testing, and optimization

• Contributed to system architecture decisions and enforced coding standards to ensure scalable and maintainable solutions

positions.title: Multimedia Specialist
positions.description:
• Built and maintained web-based and interactive applications for internal and guest-facing systems

• Supported development and deployment of digital content for interactive displays and web platforms

• Collaborated with developers and designers to deliver consistent, user-focused experiences

positions.title: Multimedia Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a custom content management system using frontend and backend technologies

• Assisted in creating and managing content for interactive touchscreen applications
